name: Orc
summary: Tireless wanderers with 120-ft Darkvision who dash with a rush of vigor and refuse to fall at 0 HP.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.summary: Bonus Action Dash and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to PB; PB uses per Short or Long Rest.
traits.text: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus and regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: See in Dim Light within 120 feet as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as if it were Dim Light.
traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.summary: Once per Long Rest, when reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, drop to 1 Hit Point instead.
traits.text: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.
